_**Agent (model default, mode Agent)**_

Implemented end-to-end device info text support and refresh behavior across iPhone views:
- tightened vertical spacing in My Device QR section
- added tappable own-device info text field with 40-char limit and server write via `setDeviceSlogan`
- added cached slogan fetch/store with stale refresh logic via `DeviceSloganCacheStore`
- updated Unknown Visitors and Visitor History rows to show device ID once, then slogan/location/relative visit age in consistent layout
- ensured unknown-visitor slogan + location refresh follows outside-map update interval
- added info row to Add/Edit Device and enabled editing for current device in Edit Device
- switched Add/Edit label from `Slogan` to `Info`
- updated string catalog translations for `Device Slogan`, `Device slogan`, `Info`, and `Max 40 characters` across all supported locales
- validated changes with simulator builds (`xcodebuild ... build`) succeeding

Also updated `CHANGELOG.md` under `version 3.0` and prepared this `.specstory` history entry for commit.
